goal: Physically controlled playable monkey in a finite forest; first integrated checkpoint is walking with camera in one clearing.
authority: Astra lead-issued bounded diagnostic tasks, executed under the existing shared slot registry. This queue does not accept game requirements or replace active coordinator claims.

tasks.objective: Determine whether the frozen walking acceptance denominator is bound to the actual training body before W05.
steps: Read W04/P02 mapping receipts and locate the exact pinned runbook, acceptance.py and trainer-body sources using read-only git show.
Trace the 13824.5 kg, 10.038 kg, 6.15 kg and transported 17.04 kg references to their distinct lineages; derive which mass the current CoT definition actually consumes.
Produce an exact source/consumer matrix and the smallest correction proposal. Do not change training seeds, thresholds or source files. Escalate if the actual frozen expression is ambiguous.
tasks.falsifier: Any conclusion using masses from different lineages as interchangeable, or claiming W04 ready while its denominator/body binding is unresolved, fails.
deliverables: report.md with exact source revisions/hashes, findings and next implementation step
receipt.json recording checks actually performed, failures and remaining gates
tasks.completion: Preserve the scoped report, cease task writes, and use worker_start.py --arrival-id YOUR_ID --finish HANDOFF_JSON with the returned handoff_template. Independent review is queued automatically; execute next assigned work. Do not mark a planning task accepted.
tasks.limits: Read referenced sources and existing receipts. No production edits, model loads, engine starts, Git operations that change source checkouts, or broad new test/build runs. Request clarification in the mailbox only for a concrete remaining decision.
